overview: This single-page file consists of a list-of-papers or cross-reference sheet concerning the shipment of seamen in Japan. It records a report from Scott at Kobe, numbered 158 and dated August 25, about shipping American citizens as seamen aboard foreign vessels at American ports, and directs researchers to file 196.2/1005 for the substantive documentation.

people.name: Scott
people.role: Sender or reporting official at Kobe; specific position not stated

subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet for Kobe report on shipping American seamen
subfiles.about: The sheet indexes and cross-references a Kobe report about shipping American citizens as seamen on foreign vessels at American ports.
subfiles.summary: This list-of-papers sheet records Kobe report no. 158 from Scott, dated August 25. The report concerned the shipment of American citizens as seamen aboard foreign vessels at American ports. A note directs the reader to file 196.2/1005 for the relevant reports, indicating that the substantive papers were filed elsewhere.

interest: The sheet is useful chiefly as an archival routing record rather than as substantive correspondence. It reveals how material about American seamen serving on foreign vessels was cross-filed within the State Department’s decimal system and preserves the existence and identifying number of a Kobe report whose full text is absent from this bundle. The discrepancy between the file numbers and the supplied file title may also help historians reconstruct filing or later cataloguing practices.
